title: "Hello and welcome! 🌱"
---

I'm Diana, a smiley seed ecologist fascinated by how seeds grow into whole habitats. My work takes me from field sites (usually tropical forests) to international conservation and restoration projects, always with one goal: protecting and restoring the world's threatened ecosystems. Make yourself at home: you can read more [about me](about.html) or [reach out](contact.html) any time.
